title: Agatha Christie's ‘Death on the Nile’ Officially Leaves Hulu in 3 Days
summary: The most expensive adaptation of Agatha Christie's seminal mystery novel Death on the Nile is about to be removed from Hulu. Find out more here.
content: When Kenneth Branagh 's star-studded update of Agatha Christie 's Murder on the Orient Express became a massive box-office hit, it was obvious which novel should be adapted next . The book ranks among the most beloved to feature Christie's iconic detective Hercule Poirot, who had previously been portrayed on screen by Peter Ustinov and David Suchet in adaptations of the same novel. For his version, Branagh assembled another star-studded cast of established names and up-and-comers, but the film received mixed reviews, underperformed at the box office, and became meme fodder on the internet.

title: Charlize Theron’s Brutal ‘John Wick’ Replacement Officially Removed From HBO Max
summary: Charlize Theron's cult classic John Wick replacement, Atomic Blonde, is officially about to leave HBO Max.
content: The John Wick universe is one of the defining action franchises of the past 20 years. Keanu Reeves and his love for his dog have powered some of the most intense and exciting action sequences of this century so far, and in 2025, the franchise shifted in a new, female-led direction. From the World of John Wick: Ballerina starred Ana de Armas as ballerina-assassin Eve Macarro, as she begins "her training in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma," and brought a new female action hero to the big screen.

title: Johnny Depp’s Comeback Movie Officially Removed From 365 Theaters
summary: Johnny Depp’s Christmas movie Ebenezer hits a box office setback after a 59% second-weekend decline, despite grossing over $80 million worldwide.
content: Of all the filmmakers who could've been tasked with bringing Charles Dickens ' A Christmas Carol back to the big screen, there was something particularly intriguing about the appointment of Ti West , given that Dickens' story is essentially a ghost story and the horror aspect of it tends to get lost in some adaptations. Throw in Johnny Depp , an actor who's spent much of his career playing the sort of characters you'd expect to find in a West movie, and you can understand why there was quite a bit of interest in the project. Depp managed to get back to the top of the domestic box office for the first time in eight years with the movie, although he's about to lose a considerable number of theaters just as we're heading into the festive season.

title: 6 Forgotten Miniseries That Are Bangers From Start to Finish
summary: These forgotten miniseries deserve the spotlight, as 'Escape at Dannemora' and 'Show Me a Hero' prove brilliant television never gets old.
content: Every great miniseries works because it treats every single scene like it matters . Instead of making viewers wait six hours for an explosive ending to finally start caring, the show gives weight to the quiet, everyday moments. For instance a woman sitting at her sewing machine, a mayor swallowing antacid before a high-stakes council vote, or a detective watching a girl walk into freezing water can be just as tense as a shootout.

title: Nicholas Hoult’s $50 Million Action Movie Officially Removed From Almost 800 Theaters
summary: Nicholas Hoult and Zoë Kravitz's $50 million action thriller How to Rob a Bank has lost more than a quarter of its theaters after just 12 days.
content: Having spent much of last summer trying to get rid of the most powerful man on the planet as Lex Luthor in James Gunn 's Superman , Nicholas Hoult has turned his attention to a rather different type of criminal enterprise this year, although he's at least had the help of a man who knows a thing or two about making entertaining action movies. Between Bullet Train , Deadpool 2 , and Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw , David Leitch has been responsible for some enormously successful action movies over the last decade, but his latest is having a particularly torrid time at the box office. With Thanksgiving weekend upon us, things don't look likely to improve for Hoult and company.

title: Two of Marvel’s Biggest X-Men Stories Officially Collide in New Release
summary: Marvel’s X-Men: Incursions #1 brings House of M and Days of Future Past together in a new release ahead of Avengers: Doomsday.
content: In the decades that Marvel has spent exploring alternate realities, f ew have presented such wildly different possibilities for mutantkind as House of M and Days of Future Past . The former saw Wanda Maximoff reshape reality, elevating mutants to positions of power and placing Magneto at the head of a royal family. The latter presented a horrifying future in which Sentinels had systematically decimated the mutant population. Naturally, Marvel has found a way to make life considerably worse for the inhabitants of both worlds.

title: Every Show Premiering on NBC in Winter 2026–2027
summary: From reboots like The Rockford Files to reality competitions like The Traitors, the NBC Winter 2026-2027 line-up is filled with great TV shows.
content: Many NBC shows premiered this fall and, like series on other networks, they will be taking a short hiatus for the holiday season before returning in the winter. Shows like The Voice will continue along with the new series Line of Fire , which has been receiving rave reviews. There's also primetime staples like St. Denis Medical , The Fall of Rise of Reggie Dinkins , Happy's Place , Dateline NBC , and all the One Chicago and Law & Order shows.

title: The First-Ever Stephen King Adaptation Officially Leaves HBO Max in 5 Days
summary: The first-ever Stephen King adaptation to hit the big screen is officially leaving HBO Max in less than one week.
content: The last few years have been full of new adaptations of Stephen King novels, both on the big and small screen. In 2025, fans found themselves flocking to one of the most underrated films of the year, The Long Walk , which was directed by Francis Lawrence . If Lawrence’s name sounds familiar, it’s because he’s the primary director for The Hunger Games franchise, including the new movie, Sunrise on the Reaping . King found success on HBO Max with the launch of the IT prequel series, Welcome to Derry , which has been officially picked up for a second season. There’s no word yet on when it will be released, but fans remain optimistic that it will make it back to streaming before the end of 2027. This would still be a two-year gap between seasons.

title: ‘Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles’ Officially Begins a Brutal New Era in Stunning Preview
summary: See exclusive artwork from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles #25 as Matthew Rosenberg previews the Turtles' biggest battle yet.
content: 40 Years ago, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles made their debut. The stars of a black-and-white indie comic by Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird , the quartet of reptilian martial artists were an instant sensation, and within a few years they were the stars of the silver screen, the small screen, and toy stores everywhere. But they've never abandoned their comic book roots: IDW now holds the rights to publish TMNT comics, and after two high-profile runs by writers Jason Aaron and Gene Luen Yang , they're headed in a new, grittier direction.

title: Tom Hanks’ Greatest Series Is a Streaming Hit With 174 Million Hours Watched
summary: Tom Hanks makes a rare TV cameo in Taylor Sheridan’s 1883, the Yellowstone prequel that drew 174 million hours of viewing on Netflix worldwide.
content: There may not be another creative storyteller working in the industry today who has more power than Taylor Sheridan and has built an empire with the slew of shows created for Paramount. While Yellowstone may have been what kicked off the entire universe, Sheridan did his best work with the limited series 1883 . In a rare appearance for a TV show too (as he is always behind the camera), Tom Hanks cameos as a Union general who comforts James Dutton after the Battle of Antietam, turning the performance into his greatest TV credit to date . In addition to being the oldest entry in the Yellowstone timeline , 1883 offered the most unique approach to telling an ensemble epic.

title: After Being Removed from 2,000 Theaters, Alexander Skarsgård’s New Adults-Only Fantasy Movie Officially Hits Digital
summary: Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård's sleeper hit fantasy romance Wicker is now available on digital after being pulled from nearly 2,000 theaters.
content: Audiences are spoiled for choice this week, with several new movies debuting theatrically and others premiering on digital platforms. The holdover hit The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is dominating the box office and is expected to retain the number-one spot over the lucrative Thanksgiving period. It does, however, have fresh competition from the animated film Hexed , the comedy sequel Focker-in-Law , and the biopic Hershey . Meanwhile, a trio of recent theatrical releases has become available to rent and purchase at home. Among them is a sleeper-hit romantic fantasy headlined by an Oscar winner.
